definition: [ מֵחַ ] noun [masculine] fatling (Phoenician מח fat (adjective ); Late Hebrew מֵיחָא figurative of choice flour ); — only plural absolute: עֹלוֺת מֵיחִים Ps 66:15 burnt offerings of fatlings ; so מֵחִים Isa 5:17 (|| כְּבָשִׂים ) according to Hi Du Che Hpt (read חֳרָבוֺת and strike out גָּרִים ); most, fat ones , figurative for rich men.
